title: neuron
description: AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot platform with 196 tools for bots, campaigns, and contacts.
summary: AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot platform with 196 tools for bots, campaigns, and contacts.
offersHint: AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot platform with 196 tools for bots, campaigns, and contacts. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.neuron.ng/mcp · Packages: npm:neuron-mcp-server

toolsPreview.name: neuron_register
toolsPreview.description: Register a new user account with name, email, password, and organization name. Creates both the user and an initial organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_login
toolsPreview.description:
Authenticate with Neuron. Three modes:
1. No args: Opens a browser URL for secure authorization (recommended — no credentials shared with AI)
2. token: Paste an MCP token from the Neuron dashboard
3. email+password: Legacy login (credentials visible to AI)

toolsPreview.name: neuron_refresh_token
toolsPreview.description: Refresh the access token using a refresh token. Automatically sets the new access token for subsequent API calls.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_switch_org
toolsPreview.description: Switch to a different organization. Returns a new access token scoped to the target organization and automatically sets it.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_organizations
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all organizations the authenticated user belongs to, including their roles in each.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_profile
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information including name, email, role, and current organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_whoami
toolsPreview.description: Check which Neuron account is currently logged in, including user name, email, role, and organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_switch_instance
toolsPreview.description:
Switch the MCP server to target a different Neuron backend instance. Auth tokens are preserved per instance — if you've previously logged in to an instance, switching back restores your session automatically.

Call with no args to list known instances and see which is active.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_logout
toolsPreview.description: Clear the current auth token locally. Does NOT revoke server-side MCP tokens — revoke from the Neuron dashboard (Settings > MCP Tokens) for full invalidation.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_bot
toolsPreview.description: Create a new AI bot with specified name, model, and behavior instructions. Returns the created bot object.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_bots
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all bots accessible to the current user, including their configurations and status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_bot
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific bot including its configuration, status, and associated resources.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_bot
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing bot's configuration. Only provided fields are modified; omitted fields remain unchanged.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_bot
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a bot and all its associated data. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_pause_bot
toolsPreview.description: Pause a bot to temporarily stop it from processing new messages. The bot retains its configuration and can be resumed later.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_resume_bot
toolsPreview.description: Resume a previously paused bot so it begins processing new messages again.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_bot_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve analytics and usage statistics for a specific bot, including message counts, response times, and conversation metrics.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_attach_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Attach a knowledge base to a bot to enhance its responses with domain-specific knowledge. Optional priority determines retrieval order when multiple knowledge bases are attached.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_bot_knowledge_bases
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all knowledge bases attached to a specific bot, including their priorities and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_detach_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Remove a knowledge base from a bot. The bot will no longer reference this knowledge base when generating responses.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Create a new API key for programmatic access to a specific bot. Store the key securely as it cannot be retrieved later.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_api_keys
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all API keys associated with a specific bot, including their names, creation dates, expiration status, and revocation status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_revoke_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Permanently revoke an API key to immediately invalidate it and prevent further programmatic access. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bot_api_chat
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to a bot via the API and receive a streaming or complete AI-generated response. Requires a valid API key with 'nrn_' prefix.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bot_api_send
toolsPreview.description: Send an outbound message through the bot API to a specified phone number. Supports text and media messages. Requires a valid API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bot_api_list_conversations
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of conversations managed by the bot. Supports filtering by conversation status. Requires a valid API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bot_api_get_messages
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve message history for a specific conversation with cursor-based pagination. Requires a valid API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bot_api_get_bot
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve configuration and status information about the bot associated with the provided API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_conversations
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of conversations for a specific bot, with optional filtering by status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific conversation, including its status, participants, and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_messages
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve messages from a specific conversation in chronological order, with optional cursor-based pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_takeover_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Transfer control of a conversation from the bot to a human agent. The bot will stop auto-responding until the conversation is released.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_release_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Release a conversation back to the bot, returning control from a human agent. The bot will resume auto-responding.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_message
toolsPreview.description: Send a message to an existing conversation. Supports text, image, and document message types with optional media attachments.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_compose_message
toolsPreview.description: Compose and send a new message to a phone number via a specific channel. Automatically creates a new conversation if one does not exist.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_whatsapp
toolsPreview.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number or group. Auto-resolves which channel to use (org default > first connected). Supports text, image, audio, video, and document types.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_edit_message
toolsPreview.description: Edit the content of a previously sent message in a conversation. Only the message sender can edit their messages.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_message
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a specific message from a conversation. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_close_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Close an active conversation, marking it as completed. The bot will stop responding and the conversation is archived.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Create a new knowledge base to store and organize information, documents, and entries.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_knowledge_bases
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all knowledge bases accessible to the current user.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific knowledge base by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Update the properties of an existing knowledge base such as name, description, or root instruction.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_knowledge_base
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a knowledge base and all its associated entries and documents.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_kb_entry
toolsPreview.description: Add a new entry (note, document, or information piece) to a knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_kb_entries
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve entries from a knowledge base with optional filtering and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_kb_entry
toolsPreview.description: Update the content, title, folder, or source of an existing knowledge base entry.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_kb_entry
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a specific entry from a knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_upload_document
toolsPreview.description: Upload a text document to a knowledge base. The document will be automatically chunked and indexed for semantic search.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_search_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Perform semantic search across all entries and documents in a knowledge base to find relevant information.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_kb_bots
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all bots that are connected to or using a specific knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_ingest_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Ingest content into a knowledge base. Supports deduplication via externalId and optional LLM processing (summarize, extract_facts, or custom instruction).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_sync_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Trigger a synchronization operation to refresh embeddings, reindex content, or update the knowledge base state.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_tool
toolsPreview.description: Create a custom API tool that the bot can invoke during conversations to fetch external data or trigger actions.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_tools
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all custom API tool integrations configured for a specific bot, including their endpoints and configuration.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_tool
toolsPreview.description: Modify an existing custom API tool's configuration, including its endpoint, authentication, or request template.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_tool
toolsPreview.description: Permanently remove a custom API tool integration from a bot. The bot will no longer be able to invoke this tool in conversations.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_test_tool
toolsPreview.description: Execute a dry-run test of a custom API tool with sample arguments to verify the endpoint responds correctly.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_add_tool_secret
toolsPreview.description: Store or update a secret credential (API key, token, etc.) for a custom tool integration. Secrets are encrypted at rest.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_remove_tool_secret
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a stored secret from a custom tool integration. The tool will lose access to this credential.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_tasks
toolsPreview.description: List all scheduled tasks for a bot. A task is a natural-language instruction the bot carries out autonomously on a schedule (e.g. 're-engage stale contacts every morning at 8am').

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_task
toolsPreview.description: Create a scheduled autonomous task for a bot. The instruction is a self-contained, natural-language directive the bot executes with its tools (find stale conversations, message contacts, schedule follow-ups, etc.). Sends are always screened against Do-Not-Contact, a per-run cap, and a no-repeat window.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_task
toolsPreview.description: Update a scheduled task's instruction, schedule, timezone, enabled state, or config. Only provided fields change.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_task
toolsPreview.description: Delete a scheduled task. This is a soft delete — the task stops running immediately.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_toggle_task
toolsPreview.description: Pause or resume a scheduled task (flips its enabled state and reschedules the next run).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_run_task
toolsPreview.description: Trigger a task to run immediately (in addition to its normal schedule). Returns once the run is queued.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_task_runs
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the paginated execution history for a task — each run's status, AI summary, tool steps, and stats (messages sent, contacts processed).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_draft_task
toolsPreview.description: Turn a plain-English description into a structured task spec (title, instruction, scheduleKind, schedule, timezone, config) WITHOUT creating it. Use the returned draft as input to neuron_create_task after any edits.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_lead_sources
toolsPreview.description: List configured lead sources for the org.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_lead_source
toolsPreview.description: Create a lead source. `config` depends on type: text_paste {text}; web_scrape {url|urls[]}; document {mediaUrl,mimeType}; tool_output {toolId,args?}; instagram/x {channelId, query?|hashtag?, limit?}; csv {rows[]}; stream {triggerTaskId?} (fed by the ingest endpoint). Set scheduleKind cron/interval/once for recurring (schedule: cron {time,days?} / interval {everyMinutes} / once {runAt}).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_run_lead_source
toolsPreview.description: Run a lead source now to pull new leads into the pool (queues the extraction).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_extract_leads
toolsPreview.description: Run a one-off extraction WITHOUT creating a persistent source, saving the results to the lead pool. Great for pasted text or a web page. `type` + `config` as in neuron_create_lead_source (e.g. type='text_paste', config={text}).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_leads
toolsPreview.description: List leads from the pool, filterable by status (new/enriched/contacted/converted/rejected), sourceId, and search.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_lead_stats
toolsPreview.description: Counts of leads by status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_convert_lead
toolsPreview.description: Promote a phone-bearing lead into a contact (so it can be messaged / added to lists). Optionally add the new contact to a list.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_personas
toolsPreview.description: List voice personas for the org. Each persona holds a voiceProfile (tone/style/themes/dos/donts) + exemplars distilled from a Collection of mined content.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_persona
toolsPreview.description: Get one voice persona (full voiceProfile + exemplars).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_build_persona
toolsPreview.description: Distill a reusable voice from a Collection of mined content: analyzes the top-engagement items and reverse-engineers a voiceProfile (tone, diction, cadence, emoji/formatting habits, themes, dos/donts) + representative exemplars. Requires the collection to have >=3 usable samples. Runs an LLM call (a few seconds).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_generate_from_persona
toolsPreview.description: Generate content written in the persona's voice for a topic/brief. Returns N variations. Stateless — nothing is persisted.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_apply_persona_to_bot
toolsPreview.description: Give a bot this persona's voice: merges a delimited voice block into the bot's system prompt (idempotent — re-applying or swapping personas replaces it cleanly) and tags the bot's metadata with the persona id.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_persona
toolsPreview.description: Update a persona's name/description, or hand-tune its voiceProfile / exemplars.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_persona
toolsPreview.description: Delete a voice persona.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Register a new inbound webhook endpoint that triggers bot actions when called by an external service.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all inbound webhooks configured for a specific bot, including their status and configuration.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Modify an existing inbound webhook's configuration, such as its name, event type, or processing prompt.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Permanently remove an inbound webhook from a bot. External services will no longer be able to trigger this endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_webhook_logs
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve execution logs for an inbound webhook to monitor incoming requests and debug processing issues.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_reflections
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve pending reflections that the bot has generated from conversations, awaiting human review. Optionally filter by approval status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_approve_reflection
toolsPreview.description: Approve a bot-generated reflection to incorporate the learned insight into the bot's future behavior and responses.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_reject_reflection
toolsPreview.description: Reject a bot-generated reflection to prevent it from being incorporated into the bot's learned behavior.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_sync_reflections
toolsPreview.description: Synchronize all approved reflections into the bot's active knowledge base, applying learned insights to future conversations.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_channels
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all WhatsApp channels configured in the current organization, including their type and connection status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_channel
toolsPreview.description: Create a new WhatsApp channel with either Meta Cloud API or Baileys (direct WhatsApp) integration. Meta Cloud channels require metaPhoneNumberId and metaAccessToken.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_channel
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific WhatsApp channel, including its configuration, type, and connection status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_channel
toolsPreview.description: Update configuration of an existing WhatsApp channel. Only provided fields are modified; omitted fields remain unchanged.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_channel
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a WhatsApp channel and disconnect any active sessions. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_assign_bot_to_channel
toolsPreview.description: Assign a bot to handle incoming messages on a specific WhatsApp channel. Replaces any previously assigned bot.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_unassign_bot_from_channel
toolsPreview.description: Remove the bot assignment from a WhatsApp channel. The channel will stop auto-responding to messages.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_start_channel_session
toolsPreview.description: Start a Baileys (direct WhatsApp) session for the channel. Generates a QR code for device pairing. Only applicable to Baileys-type channels.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_stop_channel_session
toolsPreview.description: Stop the active Baileys session for the channel and disconnect from WhatsApp. The channel can be restarted later.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_channel_status
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current connection status and session details for a specific channel (e.g., connected, disconnected, qr_pending).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_request_pair_code
toolsPreview.description: Request a numeric pairing code for a Baileys channel as an alternative to QR code scanning. Requires the phone number to pair with.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_channel_groups
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all WhatsApp groups that the channel is participating in, including group metadata.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_group_participants
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the list of participants in a specific WhatsApp group accessible through a channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_whatsapp_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve contacts from the WhatsApp account connected to this channel, with optional search filtering.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_channel_events
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the event log for a channel, including connection events, message events, and errors. Supports pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_channel_qr
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current QR code for pairing a Baileys channel with WhatsApp. A session must be started first.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_bot_channels
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all WhatsApp channels connected to a specific bot, including primary and secondary connections.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_add_bot_channel
toolsPreview.description: Connect an additional WhatsApp channel to a bot as a secondary number. The bot will respond to messages on this channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_remove_bot_channel
toolsPreview.description: Disconnect a WhatsApp channel from a bot. The bot will no longer respond to messages on this channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_browse_pool
toolsPreview.description: Browse the shared marketplace pool of published bots, tools, knowledge bases, and reflections with optional filtering by type, category, tags, or search query.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_pool_item
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific item in the marketplace pool, including its description, category, tags, and install count.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_published
toolsPreview.description: List all items the current organization has published to the marketplace pool.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_installed
toolsPreview.description: List all items the current organization has installed from the marketplace pool.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_publish_to_pool
toolsPreview.description: Publish a bot, tool, knowledge base, or reflection to the shared marketplace pool for other organizations to discover and install.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_pool_item
toolsPreview.description: Update a pool item you have published — metadata (name, description, category, tags) and content fields (setupInstructions, defaultSecrets for tool_template items). The underlying resource is re-snapshotted and version is bumped on every update.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_unpublish_from_pool
toolsPreview.description: Permanently remove a published item from the marketplace pool. Organizations that installed this item will retain their copies.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_install_from_pool
toolsPreview.description: Install a resource from the marketplace pool into the current organization. Choose 'fork' for an independent copy or 'subscribe' to receive future updates from the publisher.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_pull_pool_update
toolsPreview.description: Pull the latest updates for a subscribed pool resource to sync with the publisher's changes. Only applies to items installed with 'subscribe' mode.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_toggle_featured
toolsPreview.description: Toggle the featured status of a pool item. Featured items appear prominently in the marketplace. Requires admin privileges.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_organization
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific organization, including its name, settings, and configuration.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_organization
toolsPreview.description: Update organization settings such as name, description, or configuration preferences. Only provided fields are changed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_whatsapp_credentials
toolsPreview.description: Update WhatsApp Business API credentials for the organization. These credentials are required for sending messages via the WhatsApp Cloud API.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_set_default_channel
toolsPreview.description: Set or clear the default WhatsApp channel for the organization. The default channel is used by neuron_send_whatsapp for auto-resolving which channel to send through.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_members
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a list of all members in the organization, including their roles and permissions.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_invite_member
toolsPreview.description: Send an invitation to a new member to join the organization. The invitee receives an email with a link to accept.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_invitations
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a list of all pending invitations for the organization that have not yet been accepted or revoked.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_revoke_invitation
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a pending organization invitation so it can no longer be accepted. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_member
toolsPreview.description: Update a member's permissions within the organization, such as conversation access. Only provided fields are changed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_remove_member
toolsPreview.description: Permanently remove a member from the organization. The member loses all access immediately. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_audit_logs
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve audit logs for the organization, showing a chronological record of actions performed by members. Supports filtering by action type and resource.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_builtin_tools
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all available built-in tools with their enabled/disabled status for a specific bot. Built-in tools include WhatsApp actions (send messages, delete messages, post status), utility functions (web search, QR codes, weather), scheduling, knowledge base search, and more.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_toggle_builtin_tool
toolsPreview.description: Toggle a built-in tool on or off for a specific bot. Enabled tools become available in the bot's conversations. Example tool IDs: delete_message, post_to_channel, post_status, web_search, send_direct_message, react_to_message, set_reminder, create_poll.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_bulk_toggle_builtin_tools
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable multiple built-in tools at once for a bot. More efficient than toggling tools individually.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_outbound_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Register a new outbound webhook that sends HTTP POST requests to an external URL when specified bot events occur. Supported events: message.created, message.assistant, conversation.created, conversation.escalated, conversation.closed, bot.paused, bot.resumed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_outbound_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all outbound webhooks configured for a specific bot, including their target URLs and subscribed event types.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_outbound_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Modify an existing outbound webhook's configuration, including its destination URL, subscribed event types, or filter prompt.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_outbound_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Permanently remove an outbound webhook. The external endpoint will no longer receive event notifications from this bot.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_outbound_webhook_logs
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve delivery logs for an outbound webhook to monitor event dispatch history and debug delivery failures.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all contacts for the current organization with optional filtering by search term, tag, and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_search_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Search contacts by a query string across name, phone number, and email fields. Returns matching contacts ranked by relevance.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_contact
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific contact including their tags, notes, and associated lists.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_contact
toolsPreview.description: Create a new contact in the organization's address book. If notes are provided, they are saved as a structured note entry with source tracking.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_contact
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing contact's details. If notes are provided, they are appended as a new structured note entry without overwriting existing notes.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_contact
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a contact and remove them from all contact lists. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_export_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Export all contacts as a downloadable dataset for the current organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_import_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Bulk import multiple contacts into the organization's address book. Accepts an array of contact objects with name, phone, and optional fields.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_populate_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Enrich existing contacts with additional data from connected messaging channels. Syncs profile information from linked platforms.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_sync_whatsapp_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Synchronize contacts from all connected WhatsApp channels into the organization's contact database. Creates new contacts for unseen numbers.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_semantic_search_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Search contacts using natural language AI-powered semantic search. Finds contacts based on the meaning of their notes — skills, services, schedules, preferences, etc. Returns ranked results with relevance scores and AI-generated match reasons.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_audio_contact
toolsPreview.description: Transcribe an audio recording and extract contact information (name, phone, email, notes, tags). Automatically saves the extracted contact to the organization's address book.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_contact_lists
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all contact lists for the current organization with optional filtering by search term, type, and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific contact list, including member count and configuration.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Create a new contact list. Slug is auto-generated from name if not provided. For dynamic lists, provide criteria with rules and/or an AI prompt.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing contact list's name, slug, description, criteria, or refresh schedule.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a contact list. System-protected lists (e.g., 'Do Not Contact') cannot be deleted.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_contact_list_members
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the members of a specific contact list with optional search filtering and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_add_to_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Add one or more contacts to a list by contact ID or phone number. Phone numbers without existing contacts are auto-created as minimal contact records.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_remove_from_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Remove one or more contacts from a list by their contact IDs. Does not delete the contacts themselves.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_merge_contact_lists
toolsPreview.description: Merge two or more contact lists into a single unified list, deduplicating entries. Window merge creates a virtual union; materialized merge creates a static copy.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_find_contact_lists_for_contact
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all contact lists that a specific contact belongs to.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_refresh_contact_list
toolsPreview.description: Trigger a refresh of a dynamic contact list. Re-evaluates criteria rules and/or AI prompt and materializes updated members.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_broadcasts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all broadcasts with optional filtering by status such as draft, sent, or scheduled.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Create a new broadcast message in draft status. Provide recipients directly or use recipientSources to resolve from contact lists. The WhatsApp channel is auto-resolved if not specified.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific broadcast, including its status, message content, and recipient summary.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_broadcast_recipients
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the paginated list of recipients for a specific broadcast with their individual delivery status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing broadcast's name, message content, or media before sending. The broadcast must still be in draft status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a broadcast and its recipient data. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Send a broadcast message to all its recipients. The broadcast must be in draft status. This triggers message delivery and cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_billing
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current billing information, subscription plan, and usage details for the organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Initiate a checkout session for a subscription plan upgrade. Returns a checkout URL or confirmation to complete the purchase.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_cancel_subscription
toolsPreview.description: Cancel the current active subscription. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_upload_media
toolsPreview.description: Upload a media file (image, video, audio, or document) by providing its base64-encoded content. Returns a URL for use in messages and broadcasts.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_rewrite_text
toolsPreview.description: Rewrite or rephrase text using AI with specified tone, style, or instructions (e.g., make it more formal, translate, summarize).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_campaigns
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all campaigns for the current organization with optional status filtering and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific campaign including its status, budget, participants, and delivery metrics.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_campaign_marketplace
toolsPreview.description: Browse available campaigns in the marketplace that your organization can join to earn rewards by sending messages.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Create a new outreach campaign with target audience, messaging template, and schedule configuration. Requires a Pro or Business plan.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Update a campaign that is in 'draft' or 'rejected' status. Active or completed campaigns cannot be modified.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a campaign that is in 'draft' status. Active or funded campaigns cannot be deleted.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_submit_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Submit a draft campaign for admin review and approval. The campaign must be in 'draft' status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_fund_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Fund an approved campaign by deducting the total budget from the organization's wallet balance. Requires sufficient wallet funds.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_join_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Join a marketplace campaign as a participant to earn rewards by sending messages through your WhatsApp channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_eligible_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve contacts eligible to receive a campaign message. Respects deduplication rules and mutual contact requirements.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_campaign_message
toolsPreview.description: Send a campaign message to selected eligible contacts via WhatsApp. Requires the campaign to be in 'active' status and contacts to be eligible.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_my_participations
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all campaigns the current organization has joined as a participant, including earnings and delivery stats.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_campaign_participants
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all participants who have joined a campaign you own, including their delivery counts and earned rewards.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_pause_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Pause an active campaign to temporarily stop message delivery. Can be resumed later with the resume action.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_resume_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Resume a previously paused campaign to restart message delivery.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_stop_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Permanently stop an active campaign and refund the remaining unspent budget to the organization's wallet. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_wallet_balance
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current wallet balance for the organization, including available and pending amounts.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_wallet_transactions
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the wallet transaction history for the organization, with optional filtering by transaction type.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_fund_wallet
toolsPreview.description: Initialize a wallet funding transaction via Paystack. Returns a checkout URL to complete the payment in a browser.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_verify_wallet_funding
toolsPreview.description: Verify a wallet funding transaction using the Paystack payment reference to confirm the payment was successful.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_verify_bank_account
toolsPreview.description: Verify a Nigerian bank account number via Paystack to confirm the account holder name before saving.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_save_bank_account
toolsPreview.description: Save a verified bank account as the organization's payout destination. Verify the account first using neuron_verify_bank_account.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_bank_account
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the saved bank account details currently configured as the organization's payout destination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_request_payout
toolsPreview.description: Request a payout to transfer funds from the organization wallet to the linked bank account. A bank account must be saved first.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_payouts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the payout history for the organization, including amounts, statuses, and timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Create a new blog post in draft or published status with specified title, content, and optional metadata such as tags, excerpt, and SEO fields. Content supports full markdown (GFM) AND raw HTML — images/GIFs via ![alt](url), videos via <video>, YouTube/Loom embeds via <iframe>, collapsible sections via <details>/<summary>, plus <mark>, <kbd>, <abbr>, <div> with inline styles, etc.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_blog_posts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of blog posts with optional filtering by status, author type, author ID, or tag.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a single blog post by its URL-friendly slug, including full content and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing blog post's content, metadata, status, or SEO fields. Only provided fields are changed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a blog post by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_publish_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Publish a blog post, making it publicly visible. The post must be in 'draft' status.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_newsletters
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all WhatsApp Channel newsletters for the organization, with optional filtering by WhatsApp session channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Create a new WhatsApp Channel newsletter for one-way broadcast updates. Requires a connected Baileys session on the specified channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific WhatsApp Channel newsletter, including subscriber count and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Update the name or description of an existing WhatsApp Channel newsletter. Only provided fields are changed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a WhatsApp Channel newsletter and remove it from WhatsApp. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_post_to_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Post a message to a WhatsApp Channel newsletter. All subscribers receive the message. Provide at least one of text or mediaUrl. This triggers delivery and cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_refresh_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Re-fetch metadata (name, description, subscriber count) for a WhatsApp Channel newsletter from WhatsApp to synchronize local data.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_sync_newsletters
toolsPreview.description: Synchronize and import WhatsApp Channels from a connected WhatsApp session into Neuron. Discovers channels created outside Neuron.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_browse_list_pool
toolsPreview.description: Browse verified contact lists available in the shared marketplace pool. Filter by category, region, or search term.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_submit_to_list_pool
toolsPreview.description: Submit a contact list to the shared pool marketplace for other organizations to discover and use for ad distribution.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Create an ad distribution request to send a message to contacts in pool lists matching target demographics. Deducts from wallet upon approval.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_ad_requests
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all ad requests for the current organization with optional status filtering and pagination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_ad_request_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve delivery analytics and performance breakdown for a specific ad request, including delivery rates and cost metrics.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific ad request, including pool selections if targeting mode is manual.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Update a draft or rejected ad request. Only draft and rejected ad requests can be edited. Rejected requests revert to draft on update.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a draft ad request. Only ad requests in draft status can be deleted.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_submit_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Submit a draft ad request for admin review. The request must be in draft status. After submission, an admin must approve it before it can be funded.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_fund_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Fund an approved ad request from the organization wallet. This debits the budget amount and activates the campaign for distribution. If wallet balance is insufficient, returns shortfall information instead of an error.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_pause_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Pause an active ad request campaign. Distribution stops until resumed. Only active ad requests can be paused.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_resume_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Resume a paused ad request campaign. Distribution resumes from where it left off. Only paused ad requests can be resumed.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_stop_ad_request
toolsPreview.description: Stop an active or paused ad request campaign permanently. Any remaining unspent budget is refunded to the organization wallet. This cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_reaction
toolsPreview.description: Send or remove an emoji reaction on a WhatsApp message. Pass an empty emoji string to remove a reaction.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_sticker
toolsPreview.description: Send a WebP sticker image via WhatsApp. Only supported on Baileys channels.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_location
toolsPreview.description: Send a location pin via WhatsApp with coordinates and optional name/address.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_contact_card
toolsPreview.description: Send a vCard contact card via WhatsApp with name, phone, and optional organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_forward_message
toolsPreview.description: Forward a WhatsApp message from one chat to another. Uses copy-send approach — the message content is re-sent to the destination.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_mark_as_read
toolsPreview.description: Mark a WhatsApp message as read, sending read receipts to the sender.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_set_presence
toolsPreview.description: Set typing indicator or online/offline presence on a WhatsApp chat. Only supported on Baileys channels.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_group_invite_link
toolsPreview.description: Get the invite link for a WhatsApp group. Only supported on Baileys channels where the bot is a group admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_group_subject
toolsPreview.description: Update the name/subject of a WhatsApp group. Requires the bot to be a group admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_group_description
toolsPreview.description: Update the description of a WhatsApp group. Requires the bot to be a group admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_group_settings
toolsPreview.description: Change WhatsApp group settings: 'announcement' (only admins send), 'not_announcement' (everyone sends), 'locked' (only admins edit info), 'unlocked' (everyone edits info). Requires admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_group_members
toolsPreview.description: Add, remove, promote, or demote members in a WhatsApp group. Provide phone numbers or JIDs. Requires admin privileges.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_set_group_join_approval
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable join approval mode for a WhatsApp group. When enabled, join requests must be manually approved by admins. Requires admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_handle_join_requests
toolsPreview.description: Approve or reject pending join requests for a WhatsApp group. Requires admin privileges.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_revoke_group_invite
toolsPreview.description: Revoke the current group invite link and generate a new one. The old link will stop working. Requires admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_leave_group
toolsPreview.description: Make the bot leave a WhatsApp group. This action is irreversible — the bot will need to be re-added by an admin.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_send_poll
toolsPreview.description: Send a poll message via WhatsApp. Polls support 2-12 options and optional multi-select. Only supported on Baileys channels.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_profile_name
toolsPreview.description: Update the bot's WhatsApp display name on the given channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_profile_picture
toolsPreview.description: Update the bot's WhatsApp profile picture from an image URL.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_remove_profile_picture
toolsPreview.description: Remove the bot's WhatsApp profile picture, reverting to the default.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_profile_status
toolsPreview.description: Update the bot's WhatsApp status/bio text.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_privacy_settings
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the bot's current WhatsApp privacy settings (last seen, online, profile picture, status, read receipts, groups add).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_privacy_setting
toolsPreview.description: Update a specific WhatsApp privacy setting. Settings: lastSeen (all/contacts/contact_blacklist/none), online (all/match_last_seen), profilePicture (all/contacts/contact_blacklist/none), status (all/contacts/contact_blacklist/none), readReceipts (all/none), groupsAdd (all/contacts/contact_blacklist).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_block_contact
toolsPreview.description: Block a WhatsApp contact. Blocked contacts cannot message the bot or see its profile.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_unblock_contact
toolsPreview.description: Unblock a previously blocked WhatsApp contact.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_blocklist
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the list of all blocked WhatsApp contacts for the bot on the given channel.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_business_profile
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the WhatsApp Business profile of an external contact, including description, website, category, and business hours.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_social_channels
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all social media channels (Instagram, Twitter/X) configured in the current organization.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_create_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Create a new social media channel with platform credentials. Supports Instagram and Twitter/X. Credentials should be the full session JSON including account, cookies, headers, and platform-specific tokens.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific social media channel, including its platform, credentials status, and connection state.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing social media channel. Can update label, username, or refresh credentials.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_delete_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a social media channel and disconnect any active sessions. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_start_social_channel_session
toolsPreview.description: Start or reconnect a social media session for the channel. Initializes the platform client with stored credentials.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_stop_social_channel_session
toolsPreview.description: Stop the active session for a social media channel. The channel can be restarted later.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_social_channel_status
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the current session status for a social media channel (e.g., connected, disconnected, error).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_validate_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Test whether the stored credentials for a social channel are still valid by making a test API call to the platform.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_assign_bot_to_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Assign a bot to handle interactions on a specific social media channel. The bot will be able to use the channel's credentials for social media actions.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_unassign_bot_from_social_channel
toolsPreview.description: Remove the bot assignment from a social media channel. The bot will lose access to the channel's social media credentials.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_scheduled_messages
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a paginated list of scheduled messages for the current organization, with optional filtering by status (scheduled, sent, failed, cancelled).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_scheduled_message
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific scheduled message, including its status, send time, and message content.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_update_scheduled_message
toolsPreview.description: Update the message content, media, or send time of a scheduled message. Only messages with status 'scheduled' can be updated.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_cancel_scheduled_message
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a scheduled message to prevent it from being sent. Only messages with status 'scheduled' can be cancelled. This action cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_request_approval
toolsPreview.description: Ask a human to approve or reject an action over WhatsApp and get the decision back. The recipient replies approve/reject (optionally with a reason) or quotes the message. Use this to gate any action needing human sign-off (refunds, deploys, spend, publishing). Returns an approvalId; poll neuron_get_approval / neuron_list_approvals for the outcome, or supply a webhook in `callback` to be notified. Requires a bot API key ('nrn_' prefix).

toolsPreview.name: neuron_get_approval
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single approval request by id, including its decision once resolved. Set waitSeconds (1–60) to long-poll until it resolves. Requires a bot API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_list_approvals
toolsPreview.description: List approval requests for the organization, newest first. Filter by status (pending/approved/rejected/expired/cancelled). Requires a bot API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_respond_approval
toolsPreview.description: Approve or reject a pending approval programmatically — the decision surface for an authorized operator acting via MCP instead of replying on WhatsApp. Fires the configured callback and posts the outcome to the WhatsApp chat. Exactly-once: the first responder (here or on WhatsApp) wins; later responses return 410. Requires a bot API key.

toolsPreview.name: neuron_cancel_approval
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a still-pending approval (e.g. the upstream action was aborted). Fires the approval.cancelled callback. Requires a bot API key.
